title: Trombonists after Tricky Sam, and Britt Woodman
summary: He can't name Tricky's replacement; Britt Woodman was a good first trombonist.

story.theme_name: Trombonists: who they heard, admired and learned from
story.community_name: Talking trombonists: who played the slide and how

blocks.x: I think so. That's what I heard. And you were saying -- you mentioned to me the other day the trombone player who came in after Tricky Sam, or did the same parts, and you
couldn't think of his name. But was that Tyree Glenn you were talking about?
No, that was White, I think. He came in there and played for awhile. I think now, I don't know.

Oh, he was a good trombone player. I played with him with Nelson Riddle, and then Nat Cole and did a few recordings and with Duke Ellington, he was the first trombone player, and he was a good man. I liked him -- he did a lot of work around here.
